title: GLM mixed native search responses emit duplicate client calls with distinct IDs
wanted_capability: Reliable mixed provider-native search and client tool continuations without duplicated client execution; attribute provider emission separately from harness replay.
fallback_used: Capture/count emitted calls and executed MCP calls separately; use synthetic idempotent report sink for probes.
evidence: Flash prototype request011: duplicate tool_search; request016: duplicate bro_report and two synthetic MCP executions
checked-in runner Flash request009: duplicate tool_search, summary fails this criterion with no inconclusive checks
notes: Captured duplicates already exist inside single HTTP200 raw SSE responses under distinct call IDs, before harness client dispatch. Normal tool-only turns do not duplicate. Native calls/results replay exactly. No arbitrary same-argument dedupe added because distinct legitimate calls may intentionally repeat. Search remains enabled. Provider causality beyond mixed native/client response association remains unknown.
